name: Sparse Octree Radiance Cache
definition: A sparse octree radiance cache that replaces a dense mip-mapped volume, built on the CPU, storing aggregated radiance, albedo, alpha, and emission for blocks of voxels.
summary: The Sparse Octree Radiance Cache is a CPU-built hierarchical structure that stores radiance data sparsely with DAG deduplication to preserve thin features, unlike dense grids.
